title: Book settings
description: Facts about one book that the PDF cannot be trusted to give (ISBN, title, edition, authors) and the client profile and options chosen for it. Values never come from guesses: a draft pre-fills only what is printed, and marks the rest `to supply`.

authorgroups.description: One list per printed author group.

publisher.description: ePub dc:publisher; null: the profile's epub.metadata.publisher.

language.description: ePub dc:language (BCP 47); null: the converter's detected language, else the profile's epub.metadata.language.

publication_date.description: Date of the printed source (ISO 8601: 2026 or 2026-03-01), for the NIMAS / DAISY package (dc:Date, nimas-SourceDate). Never guessed.

rights.description: Rights statement for the package (dc:Rights); null: the profile's dtbook/daisy3 metadata.rights, else listed as to supply.

cover_image.description: Front cover image file (JPEG or PNG); a relative path is read from the settings file's folder.

profile.description: Profile name (from the store) or a path to a profile YAML.

sources.description: Where each pre-filled value was read (field -> evidence), written by the draft command.

to_supply.description: Fields a person still has to supply.
